- Bottom-right becomes the star (rotated accordingly)

This matches exactly the arrangement in option (A): heart pointing right, club pointing down, club pointing right, star. The other options fail: (B) has a club instead of a star, (C) has the wrong arrangement, (D) has the bottom-left club pointing up, (E) has wrong symbol orientations.
